FOREIGNERS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
FOREIGNERS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLIV OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Foreigners Act, 1946
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part‑I, 22nd August, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002‑Pub.
dated 22‑8‑2002.‑‑‑The following Order
promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement. ‑‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the
Foreigners (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 6, Act XXXI of 1946

FOREIGNERS (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
FOREIGNERS
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE XLIV OF
2002
An Ordinance
further to amend the Foreigners Act, 1946
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part‑I, 22nd August, 2002]
F.No.2(1)/2002‑Pub.
dated 22‑8‑2002.‑‑‑The following Order
promulgated by the President is hereby published for general information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 6, Act
XXXI of 1946.‑‑‑In the Foreigners Act, 1946 (XXXI of
1946), hereinafter referred to as the said Act, in section 6, in subsection
(2), for the words "District Magistrate and" the words "District
Coordination Officer or any officer authorised by the Federal Government
or" shall be substituted.
